title: Validate stored cart data
summary: Parse untrusted saved cart data, then choose the component tests that catch empty, malformed, and unusable states.

scenario.briefing: A saved cart from an older release contains a row with no SKU and a zero quantity. The cart page renders it and crashes when the total is formatted.

objectives.description: Validate untrusted cart data at the boundary.

hints: Return an empty array when the stored value is not an array.
Skip entries that are not objects before reading fields.
Require a non-empty string SKU and a positive integer quantity.
Return a new array that contains only the valid rows.

misconceptions.description: Casting parsed JSON without checking it.
misconceptions.feedback: A cast disappears at runtime. The saved value can be an object, a string, or a row with missing fields; parse it with real checks.

misconceptions.description: Accepting a zero or negative quantity.
misconceptions.feedback: A cart line needs at least one unit. Treat zero and negative values as invalid rather than rendering a negative total.
A full-page snapshot fails on harmless markup changes and still misses malformed data. Test the states and the parser behavior directly.

sections.title: Stored data is untrusted
sections.body: localStorage, an API, and a test fixture can all contain values that do not match the cart type. Parse the value at the boundary and return a safe result.

sections.title: Drop invalid rows, not the page
sections.body: One malformed row should not crash the cart. Filter invalid entries, keep the valid ones, and let the UI show an empty state when nothing survives.

sections.title: Test the parser before the component
sections.body: Pure parsing tests cover arrays, objects, missing fields, zero quantities, and negative values without mounting a component or mocking storage.

steps.title: Parse a saved cart safely
steps.prompt: Edit parseCart.ts. Return an empty array for non-arrays, drop malformed rows, reject non-positive quantities, and keep every valid line.
hints: Start with Array.isArray and return [] for anything else.
Inside the loop, skip null and non-object entries.
Read sku and quantity from a Record<string, unknown> after the object check.
Push only rows with a non-empty string SKU and a positive integer quantity.

tests.description: A non-array value becomes an empty cart.
tests.name: parseCart

steps.title: Choose the cart component tests
steps.prompt: Select every test case the cart component needs. Leave out cases that assert the wrong thing.
hints: Cover empty, valid, and partially invalid input.
Assert a user-visible total, not an internal variable.
Reject full-page snapshots and private state access.
Keep only observable behavior that can break for a user.

cases.label: Renders the empty-cart message when parsing returns no lines.
Renders one row for each valid parsed line.
Drops malformed stored entries instead of throwing.
Shows a total that matches the sum of price times quantity.
Asserts the full HTML string so formatting changes fail the test.
Reads private component state directly instead of rendered output.

steps.explanation: The component needs empty, valid, invalid, and total cases. Full-page snapshots are brittle, and reaching into private state tests the implementation instead of the behavior.

accessibility.summary: The workspace is keyboard accessible. Use the editor with Tab and run checks with Ctrl+Enter; every result is announced in text.
accessibility.keyboardNotes: Tab moves between the editor, hints, and results. Ctrl+Enter runs the checks. Hint buttons reveal one level at a time.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Each check announces its description, pass or fail state, and the missing or forbidden source fragment.
